context_for_next_testing_agent: Medical History feature is complete. Backend stores events in Supabase 'medical_events' table with fields: dog_id, event_type, title, description, event_date, created_at. Frontend maps event_date to 'date' field. CalendarPicker is a custom React Native component that opens a modal calendar. The historial-medico page shows filter chips (Todos, Vacuna, Revisión, Desparasitación, Medicación, Nota) and event cards with delete icons. Profile shows up to 5 recent events in preview section when medicalEvents.length > 0. Note: React Native Web has session/navigation challenges for UI automation - direct URL navigation loses auth context.
